padding_boundary: With >=2048-bit RSA and RS256/384/512 DigestInfo, valid padding is >=170 octets; no allowed-key valid-PS8 vector exists. The seven-octet negative deliberately inserts an early separator and retains the remaining full block, so it is not claimed a positive PS8 boundary proof.
